structure.note: One class of Ordinary Shares, with ADRs on Nasdaq (211,986,932 ADRs representing 423,973,864 Ordinary Shares, over 40% of the total, were held of record in the United States at March 31, 2026). Ryanair's Articles let the Directors limit the shares in which non-EU nationals have an interest, and the exercise of their rights, including voting, where that could protect the licences it needs to operate air services. The 20-F lists holders of 3% or more at March 31, 2026: Capital Group 14.6%, MFS 4.7%, Artisan Partners 4.5%, Michael O'Leary 4.0%, BlackRock 4.0% and Fidelity 3.3%.

notes: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (Ryanair's FY26; matches data.js fy 'Mar 2026'). Source is Ryanair Holdings plc's FY2026 Form 20-F as filed with the SEC (accession 0001104659-26-076131, filed June 22, 2026), which reports in euro, so currency is EUR. OWNERSHIP: the 20-F's major-shareholder table is as of March 31, 2026 and is 'based on information available to Ryanair Holdings'. It does not cite individual holder filings, so each holder's asOf is the table date. Percentages are '% of Class' of the 1,043,931,708 Ordinary Shares outstanding. HSBC, Parvus and BNP Paribas, large holders a year earlier, are no longer listed. O'LEARY: 42,199,999 Ordinary Shares (4.0%; the directors' table prints 4.00%), down from 44,099,892; he also holds 10,000,000 share options, which are not counted. His relation is 'ceo' (Group CEO). STOCK COMP: €15.0m, which rounds to 0.02 billion. Share awards are made under Option Plan 2013 and LTIP 2019 for senior employees, managers and directors; no broad employee share purchase plan was found in the 20-F, so plan is null. DIVIDENDS: €443.3m paid in FY2026 (Note 24). BUYBACKS: €536.5m of share buybacks in FY2026. XBRL: companyfacts carries no FY2026 financial facts for Ryanair (only the cover share count), so no xbrl objects are given.
